name: Alliance Trauma
summary: Skilled Alliance medics are called to Theramore Isle in Dustwallow Marsh. Instructors across Alliance capitals send accomplished practitioners to study under Doctor Gustaf VanHowzen, chief physician of the Alliance's elite medical corps.

sections.title: A Call to the Field
sections.body: When you master the healing methods taught in the great Alliance cities, local instructors have little more to teach. Those with exceptional skill in needle, cloth, and triage are brought to Doctor Gustaf VanHowzen's attention. He works from Theramore Isle, where Alliance Trauma tends the wounded in Kalimdor's fiercest warzones and beyond.

sections.title: The Road to Theramore
sections.body: Nissa Firestone in Ironforge treats VanHowzen's personal summons as a rare privilege. Theramore Isle faces regional threats, skirmishes, and harsh wilderness, so grievously wounded soldiers arrive steadily. You travel across the sea to Dustwallow Marsh to reach VanHowzen's clinic, where he tests how calmly battlefield surgeons can assess the wounded.

faq.answer: Alliance Trauma is the Alliance's elite medical corps, devoted to battlefield medicine and emergency triage. Chief Physician Gustaf VanHowzen leads it, treating critical wounds that ordinary field dressings cannot manage.

faq.q: Who sends you on this quest?
faq.answer: Alliance first aid instructors send promising practitioners once they master the standard training in their cities. Nissa Firestone in Ironforge is one such instructor.

faq.q: Where do you have to travel?
faq.answer: You travel to Theramore Isle, a human port fortress on Kalimdor's eastern coast in Dustwallow Marsh.

Doctor Gustaf VanHowzen leads Alliance Trauma as its chief physician. He works at the military clinic in Theramore and is among the Alliance's foremost authorities on emergency medicine and surgical triage.

faq.q: What happens after reporting to Doctor VanHowzen?
faq.answer: At Theramore, VanHowzen tests candidates in a hands-on triage evaluation. They must show they can save waves of dying soldiers before he admits them to the upper ranks of field medicine.

faq.q: Why is the clinic based in Theramore instead of Stormwind or Ironforge?
faq.answer: Theramore is an active frontier garrison amid hostile marshlands, dangerous beasts, and territorial skirmishes. Critically wounded troops arrive constantly, giving its clinic the steady pressure needed for advanced trauma training.

angles.text: Alliance Trauma gives frontline fighters across Kalimdor and the Eastern Kingdoms access to skilled medics who can stabilize critical injuries under fire.
As a dwarf, you may be noticed by instructors like Nissa Firestone in Ironforge, who seek promising practitioners from the Great Forge for medical service in Theramore.
